concepts.quote: StdIn is a variable that holds all the numbers, like an array.
concepts.why: StdIn is a library of static methods that consume tokens from the input stream, not a variable or container holding all the numbers.

concepts.quote: StdIn is a variable that holds all the numbers
concepts.why: Treats a variable as something that can hold many values at once, contradicting the rule that a variable holds exactly one value of its type.
The answer says nothing about the while loop, isEmpty() guard, or per-pass reading.

concepts.quote: holds all the numbers, like an array
concepts.why: Models input as a stored, re-readable collection rather than a consumed stream of unknown length read from the front.
